not_needed_reasons.GAP-DOCS-ATLAS-ARCH-001: No standalone provider-wide architecture artifact is currently required. Durable architecture decisions are already scoped to their owning programme/spec/ADR, including docs/agents/BRANCH_LIFECYCLE_ADR.md and task-specific design/spec documents. Creating docs/architecture only for symmetry would duplicate authority. Reopen this class only when a durable cross-programme Atlas architecture decision lacks an existing authoritative owner/path.
not_needed_reasons.GAP-DOCS-ATLAS-CONTRACT-001: No separate human-maintained provider-contract taxonomy is currently required. Shipped Atlas interfaces are enforced by executable tests, source contracts, accepted publication/provenance artifacts, and task-specific specifications. Creating docs/contracts only for symmetry would create a second mutable authority. Reopen this class when a recurring non-executable provider interface needs one durable owner that is not already represented by executable/schema/provenance authority.
